targets.name: Layers · locked — TWO SOURCES OF TRUTH — the padlock is drawn from a per-page localStorage set; the lock the canvas enforces is ElementData.locked on the document. Clicking writes both, the panel only ever re-reads storage, so a second machine draws an OPEN padlock over an element the canvas refuses (useLayerActions.ts:70-97,163-168; Element.ts:151-155; useSelectionBehavior.ts:88-95)
